decls.name: AtomicChangePlanning
decls.text: Each change declaration is applied to an isolated effective-model snapshot; ordered before/after target transitions produce normalized guard events, and the complete plan is committed only after every entry has been staged.

decls.name: BindingDocsCouplingContract
decls.text: Bindings enforce review coupling against normalized repo-relative changed-file paths; an allowed attestation counts only when it is new relative to the base model, or, without a base, when its declaring Shape file changed. With a base, a Shape file that changed only in attestations does not trigger a binding.

decls.name: CheckPipelineOrder
decls.text: The checker must lower the effective model before semantic rules and coverage/binding checks run.

decls.name: CoverageCurrentUpdateContract
decls.text: Coverage accepts a source reference only when its declaring Shape file matches the current changed-file input after path normalization; an attestation counts only when it is new relative to the base model, or, without a base, when its declaring Shape file changed.

decls.name: DiagnosticContract
decls.text: Diagnostics are a product surface and must keep causal paths understandable for reviewers.

decls.name: FinalForbidPrecedence
decls.text: Final forbids must remain stronger than component grants, resolve concrete targets deterministically, and cannot be waived by rationale or memory.

decls.name: ForbiddenPathWitness
decls.text: Forbidden path diagnostics must choose a deterministic fewest-hop directed witness and preserve relation kind, name, and provenance for every hop.

decls.name: FreshnessDeterminism
decls.text: Freshness compares review_by against a caller-injected ISO date, never the system clock, and enforces only ISO YYYY-MM-DD values so checks stay deterministic.

decls.name: GuardedChangePrecision
decls.text: Guards fire property-level when every protected property is detectable (a named shape trait or the description), forbid-transform guards fire when a change declares the matching transform intent, and function, component, resource, and relation targets otherwise fall back to coarse modify/remove matching, so existing coarse guards keep their behaviour and final forbids are never waived.

decls.name: GuardedSourceCurrency
decls.text: An edit to a guarded function's source is cleared only by a reevaluation written for that change. Counting any valid reevaluation, as declared changes do, would let one old review switch the guard off for every later edit.

decls.name: HypercycleWitness
decls.text: Hypercycle diagnostics need a deterministic shortest witness path so reviewers can understand the tightest rejected structural relation.

decls.name: InspectionSchemaContract
decls.text: The inspection DTO is explicitly versioned, uses stable module-qualified identities, preserves authored or generated-AST origin, uses codepoint ordering, normalizes files at the CLI boundary, and never embeds the current time.

decls.name: LoweringBeforeRules
decls.text: Module-scoped declarations, concrete forbid targets, generated candidate evidence, and change declarations must be resolved into the final effective model before derived facts are emitted.

decls.name: PreludeMetadataContract
decls.text: Prelude traits, relation kinds, and context requirements are semantic inputs shared by checker, editor, and authoring surfaces; context requirements derive obligations for function, component, and resource targets, and are merged with user-defined trait require_context obligations during checking.

decls.name: ReevaluationPolicyContract
decls.text: Reevaluation validation requires structural fields plus an approver when a project policy requires one for a sensitive memory, and validates reviewer/approver against declared roles; approver and role checks stay opt-in so the default reviewer-only path is preserved.

decls.name: RuleLayerSplit
decls.text: The loosening check restores only the rule layer (traits, rules, memory, rationale, implementations, bindings, roles, policies, and trait lists) from the base and takes every claim about the code from the head. Moving a declaration kind across that line changes which edits count as loosening, so a coding agent could silence a violation through a kind the check treats as a claim.

decls.name: ShapeSourceNormalizationContract
decls.text: Source-reference normalization must keep coverage, binding, and analyzer comparisons using the same repo-relative path rules.

decls.name: ShapeStringLiteralContract
decls.text: Shape string literal unquoting must stay consistent across lowering and formatting.

decls.name: SharedCheckPipelineOrder
decls.text: The shared lowered-model pipeline must retain model diagnostics, semantic rules, binding checks, canonical diagnostic sorting, and optional fact output in that order.

decls.name: IncrementalInvalidationContract
decls.text: Document mutations and implicit generated-AST origin changes must rebuild the complete two-pass effective model and derived facts; option-only checks may reuse the model when origins stay stable, and exact no-ops may also reuse diagnostics.

assumes.text: Claude review jobs report findings; the deterministic checker, not the model, decides the gate.
The pull request event and git merge-base name the change under review.

decls.name: ReleaseChecksumContract
decls.text: Release archives, bundled parser assets, installer templates, and checksums must stay in sync for binary installation.

decls.name: ReleaseVersionTagContract
decls.text: Release tags, the CLI package, both plugin manifests, authored notes, and current public version pins must share one version before approved release assets are published.

decls.name: SkillsApprovalReuseContract
decls.text: A skills report may be copied from this SHA's approved run, or from an ancestor when git diff --name-only --no-renames has no path under SKILLS_RELEVANT_PATH_PREFIXES. Publishing still requires an approved candidate run on the exact tag SHA.

template.name: shape.governance::Property
args: a report is copied from this SHA's approved run, or from an ancestor only when no relevant path changed

decls.name: DocsShapeBlockParsingContract
decls.text: Docs examples must be parsed with the repo parser unless explicitly marked no-verify.

decls.name: GrammarMemoryGuardForms
decls.text: Grammar changes ripple to the generated AST, parser, checker, formatter, and docs; the memory-guard protects clause supports a shape-trait form with a value and a valueless description form, guards support on_change require and forbid transform forms alongside modify-fn transform intent, review governance adds role, policy, and sensitive keywords, traits support require_context obligations, forbidden paths require explicit endpoints and relation kinds, and rationale/memory members may be grouped in nested protects/guards/who/when blocks that lower to the flat form; new keywords must also be reserved in the AST generator.

decls.name: ParseDocumentContract
decls.text: Parser output must preserve Langium document state, source URI, module-qualified references, candidate effect and forbidden path syntax, and parse diagnostics for downstream checker and editor use.

assumes.text: wasm-bindgen output preserves the native kernel's semantics in the browser build.

decls.name: AstGenerationUnknownSafety
decls.text: AST-derived architecture drafts must preserve uncertainty with effects unknown, use stable symbol or file references that do not churn on line-only movement, include compact syntax anchors with semantic fingerprints when token evidence exists, warn instead of failing on tokenless anchors, emit candidate effect evidence only as review hints with checkable pins, and keep raw syntax traces opt-in.

decls.name: AuthorPromptSafetyRules
decls.text: Authoring prompts must require stable symbol or file evidence without line suffixes, explicit destructive effects, and no memory waiver for final forbids.

decls.name: AuthoringUnknownSafety
decls.text: Generated model drafts must prefer effects unknown over false empty complete summaries.

decls.name: CliCommandDispatchOrder
decls.text: CLI commands must dispatch to the same checker/formatter/helper semantics used by tests, reject ambiguous output modes before running command work, make generated AST directory checks explicit, and derive generated AST source identity from the workspace root.

decls.name: ClockReadAtCliBoundary
decls.text: The system clock is read only at the CLI boundary to inject a freshness date; the checker never reads the clock so freshness checking stays deterministic.

decls.name: CriticPromptSafetyRules
decls.text: Critic prompts must flag unstable numbered references, omitted destructive effects, false certainty, missing reevaluations, and attempted waivers of final forbids.

decls.name: DefaultShapeFileDiscovery
decls.text: Default discovery loads every Shape file under the shape directory, including source-controlled domain packs in nested vendor directories.

decls.name: FormatterCanonicalDiffs
decls.text: Formatter ordering and indentation keep Shape files reviewable and stable in diffs, nested rationale/memory grouping blocks are canonicalized to their flat members, and graph-rule endpoints and kind filters have one canonical on-disk form.

decls.name: UpdateBinaryIntegrity
decls.text: Self-update must verify any existing target binary identity, release checksum, downloaded binary version, and bundled runtime parser assets before replacing the local executable.

decls.name: AnalyzerCheckerSeparation
decls.text: The analyzer compares source hints directly with parsed Shape and remains advisory; it does not call the authoritative deterministic checker.
